faqs.question: What does 👏🔥 mean at work?
faqs.answer: At work 👏🔥 is fine in tight teams. Across roles and seniority the reaction register can read as unprofessional; prefer sentences there.

faqs.question: Is 👏🔥 awkward?
faqs.answer: 👏🔥 can read awkward if it lands at the wrong moment. The reaction register is loud; matching it to the moment matters.

faqs.question: What does 👏🔥 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: On TikTok 👏🔥 shows up as a comment-section reaction. The reaction register is universal across audiences.

faqs.question: What does 👏🔥 mean if I do not reply?
faqs.answer: If you do not reply to 👏🔥, the combo usually stays a benign reaction. Senders rarely escalate over an unreplied reaction-coded emoji.
